entities.summary: Kfar Abida Fad'aous, sometimes spelled Kfar Aabida Faddous or Kfaraabida Fadd'ous, is a village located 2 kilometres (1.2 mi) south of Batroun in the Batroun District of the North Governorate in Lebanon.
